limitations.title: What the app doesn't track
limitations.intro: Vehiqo shows measured time next to the value set by the regulation. It does not judge whether you are compliant. The vehicle's tachograph and your own records remain the source of truth.
limitations.listTitle: The counters do not account for:
limitations.reducedRests: How many reduced daily rests you have used — the regulation allows three between weekly rests.
limitations.multiManning: Multi-manning — different rules apply with two drivers.
limitations.ferry: Interrupting a rest on a ferry or train.
limitations.straddlingWeek: A driving period crossing Sunday midnight is counted in the week it started. The regulation does not settle this case.
limitations.noRestOnRecord: Until the app has recorded your first daily rest, the daily counter starts from midnight — driving before midnight may not be included.
limitations.extensionsFromRests: How many extensions you have used is derived from the rests you record. If a rest was not recorded, the app may treat an extension as still available when it is not.
